note: For each intake test file, the reference-data lookups the Recommendation Agent should perform, and whether those lookups should succeed. Use this to validate cross-referencing, not just extraction — expected_extraction.json (in the intake-test-data package) covers extraction; this covers evaluation.

Recommendation should lean toward 'meets criteria, forward for approval' — but LVEF/QRS documentation should still be checked against CP-CARD-009 criteria 1 and 3 before a final decision.

cases.evaluation_signal: Utilization shows 14 of 20 annual visits used; the requested 12 additional would bring the total to 26 — 6 over the annual allowance, requiring a Section 3 extension justification. The appeal letter cites an Oswestry score improving from 58% to 34% (a valid objective functional outcome measure per Section 3.1) but does not state a specific bounded functional goal or expected discharge point (Section 3.2/3.3 gap). Recommendation should flag this as a partial match — likely 'needs additional documentation' rather than a clean approve or deny.
cases.notes: Best case in the set for testing nuanced, partial-criteria-met reasoning rather than a binary approve/deny. Also the second case (after EMAIL-002) that requires identity resolution before any lookup succeeds — here the letter provides enough (full name + DOB) for that resolution to work, unlike EMAIL-002.
